about.title: An engineer who writes code, fights fires and runs a city.
body: I graduated from Hacettepe University with a degree in Computer Engineering in 2005. The first nine years of my career were spent in the Ankara Metropolitan Municipality Fire Department, where I built teams, ran operations and carried decision-making responsibility in emergency scenarios.

In 2018 I moved to ASKı, the city's water and wastewater utility. As Branch Manager and then Head of Department I worked on operational transformation and the digitalisation of core services. Today I serve as a Senior Specialist at ASKı.
I have kept building software alongside all of this. İPEK Baca CRM and SimaLogistic SaaS grew out of real problems I met in the field.
